supersedes: none; protocol v1 (cr01-sparse-estimation-v1, sha256 f09d8331cdab54b6e4421d5fd11d186dc14e2adc1e3f817f9f3b1eb65e33915c) and its FAIL result stay as recorded
question: Which sparse evidence could a reel passport carry instead of a 65-77.5 K scaling-law fit? (a) A few low-temperature short-sample points per product, fitted with the same scaling law and used inside the temperature range they span. (b) A single in-field scanner reading per tape, scaled to the operating point by a population lift factor.
evidence_class: development-grade registered retrospective on public measured data. NOT blind: protocol v1 scored the same target nodes, and its per-product errors and a few target values were read before this protocol was written. A v2 PASS identifies a candidate method only; confirmation needs data used in neither v1 nor v2 (CR-04 or an external dataset).
seen_status: All 20-40 K, 5/7/8 T perpendicular target values were used in v1 scoring and their per-product error summaries were read. The v2 training-node choices below were made from node coordinates (which (T, B) nodes exist per product), not from values.

data.source: Robinson Research Institute HTS critical current database, figshare collection 2861821 (CC BY 4.0)
data.quantity: ic_a_per_m (critical current per unit tape width, A/m)
data.products_in_headline: every dataset in sources.json except those flagged not_a_tape

node_definition: identical to protocol v1 node_definition (temperature, field, angle, perpendicular, node_value, self_field_value)

targets.rule: every (T, B) target node present in the product's data, excluding any node that is a training node of the scenario

S3_short_sample_low_field.role: product short-sample characterisation at modest field: field extrapolation from <= 3 T to 5-8 T, temperature interpolation within 20-40 K
S3_short_sample_low_field.training_nodes: the six perpendicular nodes (T, B) with T in {20, 30, 40} K and B in {2, 3} T
S3_short_sample_low_field.pre_declared_expectation: uncertain; the field exponent fitted at 2-3 T may not hold to 8 T

S4_short_sample_two_temperatures.role: product short-sample characterisation at two temperatures reaching 5 T: field extrapolation 5 to 7-8 T, temperature interpolation 20-40 K
S4_short_sample_two_temperatures.training_nodes: the four perpendicular nodes (T, B) with T in {20, 40} K and B in {3, 5} T

S5_inField_lift_70K_3T.role: a single in-field scanner reading per tape (70 K, 3 T; every product has this node, 65 K / 3 T is missing for several), scaled by the population
S5_inField_lift_70K_3T.base_value: node_value(70 K, 3 T) of the product
S5_inField_lift_70K_3T.prediction: base_value(product) x median over all OTHER headline products having both quantities of [node_value(T,B) / base_value] at the same target node (leave-one-product-out lift, as v1 S0)
S5_inField_lift_70K_3T.pre_declared_expectation: better than v1 S0 (77 K self-field); PASS uncertain

S6_inField_lift_77K_1T.role: a single liquid-nitrogen in-field reading per tape (77.5 K, 1 T), scaled by the population
S6_inField_lift_77K_1T.base_value: node_value(77.5 K, 1 T) of the product

M1.form: ln Ic = c0 - T / Tstar - alpha * ln B (as protocol v1)
M1.fit: ordinary least squares in ln Ic over the scenario's training nodes
M1.uncertainty: 95% prediction interval with Student t at (n_train - 3) degrees of freedom; reported, coverage is not gating

M2.status: secondary, reported for S3 only (S4 has too few nodes), cannot change any verdict
M2.form: ln Ic = c0 - T / Tstar - (a0 + a1 * T) * ln B (as protocol v1)

metrics: identical to protocol v1 (relative_error, worst_overprediction, p95_abs_error with numpy-default linear interpolation, interval_coverage for M1 scenarios)

product.NOT_EVALUATED: a required training or base node is missing, or no target nodes remain
product.INCONCLUSIVE: fit numerically degenerate (non-finite parameters or Tstar <= 0)

scenario_headline.PASS: at least 80% of evaluated headline products PASS; evaluated = PASS + FAIL + INCONCLUSIVE

verdicts.strata: headline (20 tape products), previously_used (the four v1 stratum products), ceraco reported separately

implementation_conventions: as recorded for v1 attempt 01: node rounding round-half-up; perpendicular means an exact multiple of 180 deg

software_gates.G1_synthetic_recovery: for S3 and S4, data generated exactly from M1 with known parameters on each product's training/target node layout is recovered to relative parameter error <= 1e-9 and target relative error <= 1e-9; for S5 and S6, a synthetic population in which every product's Ic is a fixed multiple of one common map is predicted to relative error <= 1e-9
software_gates.G2_independent_checker: a separate checker that does not import the runner recomputes every node value, prediction, metric and verdict; integers, strings and verdicts must match exactly and floating-point values to relative 1e-9
software_gates.G3_coverage_accounting: every product appears with a verdict for every scenario; no product is dropped

falsifiers: A FAIL stands; the model, tolerances, node choices and targets are not changed to recover a PASS. Any revised method is a new protocol version.

S5 or S6 'improves on v1 S0' only if, over headline products evaluated in both, its median p95_abs_error is lower than S0's AND its count of products with worst_overprediction <= 0.10 is not lower than S0's (v1 S0 values recomputed by the v2 runner with the v1 rule). Otherwise an in-field reading is not shown to be a better per-tape base than the 77 K self-field rating for this database, and that is reported.
not_tested: whether a scanner ranks or scales reels within one product; the database has one sample per product
